payload.core_composition_summary: Bit preprocessing to quickly find 3-cycles and build sparse graph; then BFS for shortest cycle.
payload.rationale: Uses bit counts to detect triangles (t>=3) and construct graph edges efficiently; then BFS finds shortest cycle.
